description: Source code for IO base functions used in zlib compression/uncompression with zip API, including file operation callbacks.

methods.name: fopen_file_func
methods.description: Opens a file with mode depending on input flags.

methods.name: fread_file_func
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream.

methods.name: fwrite_file_func
methods.description: Writes data to a file stream.

methods.name: ftell_file_func
methods.description: Returns current position in file stream.

methods.name: fseek_file_func
methods.description: Seeks to a position in file stream based on offset and origin.

methods.name: fill_fopen_filefunc
methods.description: Fills a zlib_filefunc_def structure with function pointers for file operations.
